title: Read-only week view
lead: A read-only page for the current week: seven dates, each night's meal title, and a link to its recipe (P1).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** swap, skip, lock or made controls (S21, S22); editing the plan; past or future weeks; the shopping list.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: P1 asks for tonight's dinner and a simple week view. S22 delivers tonight only. A paired member who does not plan can see the week without opening the planning session, and the glanceable Today page stays uncluttered.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
None. The planning rules interview is done (ADR 0013 Rules, S19): the planning week starts on Sunday and covers 7 nights; a night with no meal shows as empty; everyone can view the plan.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-06, spec-check answer: a week that exists only as an unconfirmed draft is shown with its saved meals and a 'Draft, not confirmed yet' line, as the Today view shows planned meals; the confirmed state comes from meal_plan.confirmed_at. Any further small implementation detail this spec does not cover is the implementer's call within the decisions above; list each such choice in the report's deviations so the owner can review it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/larder/web/week_views.py` (blueprint `week`, route `GET /week`)
- `src/larder/web/templates/week.html`
- `src/larder/web/templates/base.html` (a "Week" link in the header for any paired person)
- `src/larder/web/__init__.py` (register the blueprint in `create_app`)
- `src/larder/planner_db.py` (SQL: `week_meals(conn, week_start)`; create the file if S21 has not, otherwise add to it)
- `tests/test_week.py`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `tests/test_week.py`, built on `WebShellTestCase` (`tests/test_web_shell.py`):
1. `test_week_shows_seven_dates_with_meal_titles`
2. `test_night_without_a_meal_is_shown_empty`
3. `test_meal_title_links_to_the_recipe_view` (the href comes from `url_for` on S14's recipe view endpoint, not a hard-coded path)
4. `test_no_plan_shows_a_friendly_message`
5. `test_member_can_open_the_week` (not admin-only)
6. `test_page_has_no_forms_or_controls` and `test_post_is_not_allowed` (405)
7. `test_unpaired_device_gets_401`
8. `test_header_has_a_week_link_for_paired_people`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `planner_db.week_meals(conn, week_start)` returns the `planned_meal` rows of the `meal_plan` with that `week_start`, joined to `recipe.title`, ordered by date then id. `planned_meal` is not unique on (meal_plan_id, date), so a date can have several rows; show them all.
2. The view finds the plan that contains today (today in `settings.timezone`; the host's local time when it is unset), builds the seven ISO dates from `week_start`, and renders them.
3. Register the blueprint in `create_app` after `auth_views.init_app`. Do not add the endpoint to `_OPEN_ENDPOINTS`: the device guard in `auth_views` already answers 401 for unpaired devices.
4. Template extends `base.html`; no inline script or style (`TemplateRulesTest`).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Web tests pass; on the dev server a paired phone shows the planned week and an unpaired browser gets the 401 page.
